title: Posterior Consistency under dependent errors in non-linear inverse problems with applications to time evolution equations
summary: Let $θ\to \mathcal G(θ)$ be a map from a parameter to the solution of some non-linear partial differential equation modelling a dynamical system. We provide conditions to show posterior consistency for $θ$ under observations of $\mathcal G(θ)$ with dependent noise, modelling potential time-correlations of the sensors used to make the measurements.
